output.reason: [ev-875bb56564b0] says, under "Changed Metrics", that the metric `lbipam_ips_available_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_ips_available`, so the change type "renamed" and the before/after literals are right. The proposal breaks the rename, though: its replacedBy has the same identity as the subject, so it records nothing. It also puts the product in a field, which the rules forbid. The corrected version names the subject after the old metric name and replacedBy after the new one, both as kebab-case protocol-behavior names, because no family is specific to metrics.

correction.statement: The LB-IPAM metric lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available in Cilium 1.17.0.
